mapper.select:
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER) AS MEMBER_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE STATUS != 'DELETED') AS CONTENT_REVIEW_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW) AS PRODUCT_REVIEW_COUNT,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR LEFT JOIN REVIEW R ON RR.CONTENT_REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO WHERE RR.STATUS = 'WAITING' AND ( RR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' OR R.STATUS != 'DELETED' ) ) AS REPORT_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING') AS BUSINESS_REQUEST_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING') AS PRODUCT_REQUEST_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EVENT WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING') AS EVENT_REQUEST_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SETTLEMENT WHERE STATUS = 'WAITING') AS SETTLEMENT_WAITING_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MEMBER_NO) FROM ACCESS_LOG WHERE TRUNC(CREATED_AT) = TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AS VISITOR_COUNT
FROM DUAL
mapper.sql:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND ROLE = 'USER' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER_SOCIAL MS WHERE MS.MEMBER_NO = MEMBER.MEMBER_NO )
AND ROLE = 'USER' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER_SOCIAL MS WHERE MS.MEMBER_NO = MEMBER.MEMBER_NO )
AND ROLE = 'BUSINESS'
AND ROLE IN ('USER', 'BUSINESS')
AND STATUS = #{status}
AND MEMBER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND MEMBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
AND ( MEMBER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR MEMBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
mapper.select:
SELECT MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, EMAIL AS EMAIL, PHONE AS PHONE, ROLE AS ROLE, STATUS AS STATUS, CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT, WITHDRAWN_AT AS WITHDRAWN_AT, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER_SOCIAL MS WHERE MS.MEMBER_NO = MEMBER.MEMBER_NO ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS SNS_YN FROM MEMBER
ORDER BY MEMBER_NO DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ACTIVE_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS BLOCKED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WITHDRAWN_COUNT FROM MEMBER WHERE ROLE IN ('USER', 'BUSINESS')
mapper.update:
UPDATE MEMBER
SET STATUS = #{status}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE, WITHDRAWN_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'WITHDRAWN' THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END
WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
AND STATUS != 'WITHDRAWN'
mapper.select:
SELECT MEMBER_NO FROM MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN' AND MEMBER_NO IN
#{memberNo}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM SETTLEMENT WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO IN ( SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO WHERE O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} )
DELETE FROM DELIVERY WHERE ORDER_ITEM_NO IN ( SELECT OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO WHERE O.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} )
mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_NO FROM MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'WITHDRAWN' AND WITHDRAWN_AT <= SYSDATE - 7

SELECT R.REVIEW_NO AS REVIEW_NO, R.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, R.CONTENT_NO AS CONTENT_NO, C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, R.RATING AS RATING, R.REVIEW_TEXT AS CONTENT, R.STATUS AS STATUS, R.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM REVIEW R JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = R.CONTENT_NO WHERE R.STATUS != 'DELETED'
AND ( M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR C.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT R.REVIEW_NO AS REVIEW_NO, R.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, R.CONTENT_NO AS CONTENT_NO, C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, R.RATING AS RATING, R.REVIEW_TEXT AS CONTENT, R.STATUS AS STATUS, RC.REPORT_COUNT AS REPORT_COUNT, R.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT
FROM REVIEW R
JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = R.MEMBER_NO
JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = R.CONTENT_NO
JOIN ( SELECT CONTENT_REVIEW_NO, COUNT(REPORT_NO) AS REPORT_COUNT FROM REVIEW_REPORT WHERE REVIEW_TYPE = 'CONTENT' AND STATUS = 'WAITING' GROUP BY CONTENT_REVIEW_NO ) RC ON RC.CONTENT_REVIEW_NO = R.REVIEW_NO
WHERE R.STATUS != 'DELETED'
AND ( M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CONTENT C WHERE C.CONTENT_NO = R.CONTENT_NO AND C.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) )
ORDER BY R.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW_REPORT SET STATUS = #{status}, PROCESSED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CONTENT_REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND REVIEW_TYPE = 'CONTENT' AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
UPDATE REVIEW SET STATUS = 'DELETED', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REVIEW WHERE STATUS != 'DELETED') AS TOTAL_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RR.CONTENT_REVIEW_NO) FROM REVIEW_REPORT RR JOIN REVIEW R ON R.REVIEW_NO = RR.CONTENT_REVIEW_NO WHERE RR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'CONTENT' AND RR.STATUS = 'WAITING' AND R.STATUS != 'DELETED' ) AS REPORT_COUNT FROM DUAL

SELECT PR.REVIEW_NO AS REVIEW_NO, PR.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, PR.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, PR.RATING AS RATING, PR.CONTENT AS CONTENT, PR.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW PR JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = PR.MEMBER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = PR.PRODUCT_NO WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY PR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT PR.REVIEW_NO AS REVIEW_NO, PR.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, PR.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, PR.RATING AS RATING, PR.CONTENT AS CONTENT, COUNT(RR.REPORT_NO) AS REPORT_COUNT, PR.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW PR JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = PR.MEMBER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = PR.PRODUCT_NO JOIN REVIEW_REPORT RR ON RR.PRODUCT_REVIEW_NO = PR.REVIEW_NO AND RR.REVIEW_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' AND RR.STATUS = 'WAITING' WHERE 1 = 1
AND ( M.NICKNAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
GROUP BY PR.REVIEW_NO, PR.MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME, PR.PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME, PR.RATING, PR.CONTENT, PR.CREATED_AT ORDER BY PR.CREATED_AT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEW_REPORT SET STATUS = #{status}, PROCESSED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PRODUCT_REVIEW_NO = #{reviewNo} AND REVIEW_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' AND STATUS = 'WAITING'
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM PRODUCT_REVIEW) AS TOTAL_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PRODUCT_REVIEW_NO) FROM REVIEW_REPORT WHERE REVIEW_TYPE = 'PRODUCT' AND STATUS = 'WAITING' ) AS REPORT_COUNT FROM DUAL

SELECT
E.EVENT_NO AS eventNo, E.TITLE AS title, E.START_DATE AS startDate, E.END_DATE AS endDate, E.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, E.STATUS AS status,
MIN(B.BUSINESS_NAME) AS businessName,
LISTAGG(P.PRODUCT_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EP.EVENT_PROD_NO) AS productName, MIN(P.PRICE) AS price,
MAX(EP.EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE) AS eventDiscountRate,
LISTAGG( P.PRODUCT_NAME || '|' || EP.EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE || '|' || P.PRICE || '|' || ROUND(P.PRICE * (100 - EP.EVENT_DISCOUNT_RATE) / 100) || '|' || B.BUSINESS_NAME, ';' ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EP.EVENT_PROD_NO) AS productDetail
FROM EVENT E
JOIN EVENT_PRODUCT EP ON E.EVENT_NO = EP.EVENT_NO
JOIN PRODUCT P ON EP.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO
JOIN BUSINESS B ON P.BUSINESS_NO = B.BUSINESS_NO
WHERE 1=1
AND E.STATUS = 'WAITING'
AND E.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
AND E.STATUS = 'END'
AND E.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)
AND E.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 7
AND E.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 30
AND ( E.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR B.BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
GROUP BY E.EVENT_NO, E.TITLE, E.START_DATE, E.END_DATE, E.CREATED_AT, E.STATUS
ORDER BY E.EVENT_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'WAITING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WAITING_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS APPROVED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'END' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS END_COUNT FROM EVENT

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.BUSINESS_NO AS BUSINESS_NO, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, P.CONTENT_NO AS CONTENT_NO, C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, P.PRODUCT_TYPE AS PRODUCT_TYPE, P.PRICE AS PRICE, P.DISCOUNT_RATE AS DISCOUNT_RATE, P.STOCK AS STOCK, P.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, P.STATUS AS STATUS, PI.IMAGE_PATH AS MAIN_IMAGE, P.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM PRODUCT P JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = P.BUSINESS_NO JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_IMAGE PI ON PI.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO AND PI.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE 1 = 1
AND P.STATUS = 'WAITING'
AND P.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
AND P.STATUS = 'DELETE_REQUESTED'
AND ( B.BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY P.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS TOTAL_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'WAITING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS WAITING_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS APPROVED_COUNT, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'DELETE_REQUESTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DELETE_REQUESTED_COUNT FROM PRODUCT
SELECT IMAGE_PATH FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND IMAGE_PATH IS NOT NULL ORDER BY IMAGE_NO

SELECT O.ORDER_NO AS ORDER_NO, OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE AS PRODUCT_PRICE, OI.QUANTITY AS QUANTITY, NVL(D.STATUS, 'PREPARING') AS STATUS, OI.BUSINESS_NO AS BUSINESS_NO, M.MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, O.TOTAL_AMOUNT AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, O.ORDER_STATUS AS ORDER_STATUS, O.RECEIVER_NAME AS RECEIVER_NAME, O.RECEIVER_PHONE AS RECEIVER_PHONE, O.ADDRESS AS ADDRESS, D.TRACKING_NUMBER AS TRACKING_NUMBER, D.COURIER AS COURIER, O.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN ORDERS O ON O.ORDER_NO = OI.ORDER_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = O.MEMBER_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO LEFT JOIN DELIVERY D ON D.ORDER_ITEM_NO = OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO WHERE OI.STATUS != 'CANCELED'
AND P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY O.ORDER_NO DESC

SELECT CR.CANCEL_NO AS CANCEL_NO, CR.ORDER_NO AS ORDER_NO, OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO AS ORDER_ITEM_NO, OI.PRODUCT_NO AS PRODUCT_NO, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, C.TITLE AS CONTENT_TITLE, OI.QUANTITY AS QUANTITY, OI.PRODUCT_PRICE AS PRODUCT_PRICE, M.MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, CR.CANCEL_TYPE AS CANCEL_TYPE, CR.REFUND_AMOUNT AS REFUND_AMOUNT, CR.REASON AS REASON, CR.STATUS AS CANCEL_STATUS, CR.REJECT_REASON AS REJECT_REASON, CR.PROCESSED_AT AS PROCESSED_AT, CR.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM CANCEL_REQUEST CR JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON OI.ORDER_ITEM_NO = CR.ORDER_ITEM_NO JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = OI.PRODUCT_NO JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_NO = P.CONTENT_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = CR.MEMBER_NO WHERE 1 = 1
AND CR.STATUS = #{status}
AND P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY CR.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT B.BUSINESS_NO AS BUSINESS_NO, B.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, M.EMAIL AS EMAIL, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, B.BUSINESS_NUMBER AS BUSINESS_NUMBER, B.BANK_NAME AS BANK_NAME, B.ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER, B.ACCOUNT_HOLDER AS ACCOUNT_HOLDER, B.GRADE_NAME AS GRADE_NAME, B.CUSTOM_RATE AS CUSTOM_RATE, B.STATUS AS STATUS, B.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM BUSINESS B JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.STATUS = 'APPROVED'
AND ( B.BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR M.MEMBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR M.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY B.BUSINESS_NO DESC

SELECT B.BUSINESS_NO AS BUSINESS_NO, B.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.MEMBER_ID AS MEMBER_ID, M.EMAIL AS EMAIL, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, B.BUSINESS_NUMBER AS BUSINESS_NUMBER, B.BANK_NAME AS BANK_NAME, B.ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER, B.ACCOUNT_HOLDER AS ACCOUNT_HOLDER, B.GRADE_NAME AS GRADE_NAME, B.CUSTOM_RATE AS CUSTOM_RATE, B.STATUS AS STATUS, B.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT FROM BUSINESS B JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_NO = B.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.STATUS = 'WAITING'
AND ( B.BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR M.MEMBER_ID LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR M.EMAIL LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY B.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT MIN(S.SETTLEMENT_NO) AS SETTLEMENT_NO, S.BUSINESS_NO AS BUSINESS_NO, B.BUSINESS_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, TO_CHAR(TRUNC(S.CREATED_AT, 'MM'), 'YYYY-MM') AS SETTLEMENT_MONTH, SUM(S.TOTAL_AMOUNT) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT, MAX(S.APPLIED_GRADE) AS APPLIED_GRADE, MAX(S.APPLIED_RATE) AS APPLIED_RATE, SUM(S.FEE_AMOUNT) AS FEE_AMOUNT, SUM(S.FEE_AMOUNT) AS SETTLED_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN S.STATUS = 'REQUESTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REQUESTED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN S.STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN S.STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'WAITING' END AS STATUS, B.BANK_NAME AS BANK_NAME, B.ACCOUNT_NUMBER AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER, B.ACCOUNT_HOLDER AS ACCOUNT_HOLDER, MAX(S.SETTLED_AT) AS SETTLED_AT, MIN(S.CREATED_AT) AS CREATED_AT FROM SETTLEMENT S JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = S.BUSINESS_NO WHERE S.STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'DONE', 'REJECTED')
AND B.BUSINESS_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
GROUP BY S.BUSINESS_NO, B.BUSINESS_NAME, TRUNC(S.CREATED_AT, 'MM'), B.BANK_NAME, B.ACCOUNT_NUMBER, B.ACCOUNT_HOLDER ORDER BY MIN(S.CREATED_AT) DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE SETTLEMENT SET STATUS = #{status}, SETTLED_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'DONE' THEN SYSDATE ELSE NULL END WHERE BUSINESS_NO = #{businessNo} AND CREATED_AT >= TO_DATE(#{settlementMonth} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND CREATED_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TO_DATE(#{settlementMonth} || '-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 1) AND STATUS IN ('REQUESTED', 'DONE', 'REJECTED')
mapper.select: SELECT M.MEMBER_NO AS MEMBER_NO, M.NICKNAME AS NICKNAME, LOG.LAST_ACCESS_AT AS LAST_ACCESS_AT, LOG.ACCESS_IP AS ACCESS_IP, NVL(CLICK.PRODUCT_CLICK_COUNT, 0) AS PRODUCT_CLICK_COUNT FROM MEMBER M LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER_NO, COUNT(*) AS PRODUCT_CLICK_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_CLICK_LOG WHERE MEMBER_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MEMBER_NO ) CLICK ON CLICK.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MEMBER_NO, MAX(CREATED_AT) AS LAST_ACCESS_AT, MAX(ACCESS_IP) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY CREATED_AT) AS ACCESS_IP FROM ACCESS_LOG WHERE MEMBER_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY MEMBER_NO ) LOG ON LOG.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE M.ROLE = 'USER' ORDER BY LOG.LAST_ACCESS_AT DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(A.CREATED_AT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ACCESS_DATE, COUNT(DISTINCT A.MEMBER_NO) AS VISITOR_COUNT FROM ACCESS_LOG A WHERE A.MEMBER_NO IS NOT NULL AND A.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE) - 6 GROUP BY TRUNC(A.CREATED_AT) ORDER BY TRUNC(A.CREATED_AT)

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME AS PRODUCT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS CLICK_COUNT FROM PRODUCT_CLICK_LOG L JOIN PRODUCT P ON P.PRODUCT_NO = L.PRODUCT_NO GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 5

SELECT C.CONTENT_NO AS CONTENT_NO, C.TMDB_ID AS TMDB_ID, C.CONTENT_TYPE AS CONTENT_TYPE, C.TITLE AS TITLE, C.ORIGINAL_TITLE AS ORIGINAL_TITLE, C.OVERVIEW AS OVERVIEW, C.POSTER_PATH AS POSTER_PATH, C.BACKDROP_PATH AS BACKDROP_PATH, C.RELEASE_DATE AS RELEASE_DATE, C.GENRE_TEXT AS GENRE_TEXT, C.RUNTIME AS RUNTIME, C.EPISODE_COUNT AS EPISODE_COUNT, C.DIRECTOR AS DIRECTOR, C.CAST_NAMES AS CAST_NAMES, C.AGE_RATING AS AGE_RATING, C.TMDB_SCORE AS TMDB_SCORE, C.VIEW_COUNT AS VIEW_COUNT, ( SELECT LISTAGG(OP.PLATFORM_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY OP.PLATFORM_NAME) FROM CONTENT_PLATFORM CP JOIN OTT_PLATFORM OP ON OP.PLATFORM_NO = CP.PLATFORM_NO WHERE CP.CONTENT_NO = C.CONTENT_NO ) AS PLATFORM_NAMES, C.CREATED_AT AS CREATED_AT, C.UPDATED_AT AS UPDATED_AT FROM CONTENT C WHERE 1 = 1
AND C.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY C.CONTENT_NO DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE CONTENT SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT_TYPE = #{contentType}, GENRE_TEXT = #{genreText}, CAST_NAMES = #{castNames}, OVERVIEW = #{overview}, RUNTIME = #{runtime}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE CONTENT_NO = #{contentNo}
mapper.select: SELECT PLATFORM_NO AS PLATFORM_NO, PLATFORM_NAME AS PLATFORM_NAME, LOGO_IMAGE AS LOGO_IMAGE, SITE_URL AS SITE_URL, IS_ACTIVE AS IS_ACTIVE FROM OTT_PLATFORM ORDER BY PLATFORM_NO
mapper.update: UPDATE OTT_PLATFORM SET SITE_URL = #{siteUrl}, IS_ACTIVE = #{isActive}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE PLATFORM_NO = #{platformNo}
